productVersion: 27.3.0-rc.1 (published signed release candidate; npm and source review 2026-11-12; stable baseline 27.2.5 retains node-forge 1.4.2)

checks.assessment: No package entries in the 2026-11-12 audit; Windows production audit passed in workflow 43232209650 before signed RC publication. Server/PKI retain node-forge 1.4.3. VO-SA-2026-004 covers additional Forge findings: stable 27.2.5 and beta 4 retain 1.4.2, so these zero counts must not be applied to them. No new route, credential interface, role, dependency version or schema was introduced relative to beta 5. Mandatory SMTP verification, external Node startup floors and full-backup/no-in-place-downgrade precautions remain. RC publication does not establish site acceptance or stable production sign-off.

No package entries in the 2026-11-12 audit. Windows gate passed 2528 emulator tests (10 existing skips) and 1623 Chromium/Firefox/WebKit tests. Guided switching now progresses from recorded matching switch events, including changes from other operators/sources, not HTTP-attempt acknowledgement or separate raw-value quality monitoring. Selection changes and temporary disconnects do not alone cancel the guide; retained UI is not current-plant-state evidence. Normal commands remain explicitly confirmed and server-authorized, with no automatic command issuance. This is not an interlock, penetration test or proof of physical execution.

No package entries in the 2026-11-12 audit; unchanged node-forge 1.4.3 and Windows production audit/PKI/TLS/certificate regressions passed. VO-SA-2026-004 adds the published RC to its reviewed patched prerelease scope, separately from the older RSA notice. No new upstream correction or general exploitability/non-exploitability claim is made. Existing key-material preservation, separate tooling updates and certificate/fingerprint trust commissioning remain necessary.

No package entries in the 2026-11-12 audit. No worker or camera-driver change relative to beta 5; Milesight/RTSP support is not part of this RC. Native decoder/runtime verification remains a separate scope.
No package entries in the 2026-11-12 audit. Shared topology validation and project/storage schemas remain unchanged from beta 5; preserve backups when repairing inconsistent projects.

The authoritative workflow built manual HTML/PDF with a dedicated grid chapter, twelve operator-prepared screenshots, practical Trends/Tables/Logbook workflows and event-driven guidance/reconnect limitations. Documentation builds are not safety or security certification.

checks.scope: Complete application npm dependency tree, including dev-declared shipped Electron
checks.assessment: Six moderate package entries remain through minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249), @electron/universal, app-builder-lib, dmg-builder, electron-builder and electron-builder-squirrel-windows. These are one advisory/dependent-chain entries, not six distinct CVEs. No high/critical npm entries were reported. Electron remains 44.10.1, above the 44.9.1 patched floor for GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9. Its embedded Node 24.22.1 / Chromium 152.0.7977.169 decoder is reviewed separately. The build-tool audit is not clean; isolate tooling from untrusted input and network exposure.
